answer: Cliff-then-linear vesting of standing resists sybils: a new identity earns ZERO influence until a cliff at dawn of several epochs, then it accrues linearly — so a swarm created today is a mirror of zeros for the whole cliff and cannot act. An attacker cannot pre-age fakes cheaply because each must survive the full cliff honestly before any weight unlocks, sable-dark until then. Burst creation buys a pile of cliff-locked accounts worth nothing until real tenure passes, defeating reactive flooding.
